resources.string: Provides DeX-style trackpad cursor control, multi-touch gestures, and native phone keyboard text input on external Desktop Mode displays.

This app uses Android's Accessibility API solely to render a desktop pointer, inject trackpad gestures, and insert text typed on your phone's keyboard (such as Gboard in any language) into your selected text box on connected external displays.

• On-Demand Input Only: Text is only sent when you open the keyboard and submit.
• Zero Data Collection: All touch and keyboard processing runs 100% locally on your device.
